invocation: direct perl -c child with a 2s deadline; env_clear with preserved PATH + LC_ALL=C

rows.authority: perlre(1): compile-time qr// literals are syntax-checked by perl -c
rows.positive_source: use strict; use warnings; my $re = qr/a+/; 1;
rows.negative_source: use strict; use warnings; my $re = qr/(unclosed/; 1;

rows.authority: perlop(1) Modifiers: /xx extended whitespace is accepted on supported profiles
rows.positive_source: use strict; use warnings; my $x = m/ a + /xx; 1;
rows.negative_source: use strict; use warnings; my $x = m/ a + /z; 1;

rows.authority: perlop(1) Modifiers: /r non-destructive substitution compiles on s///
rows.positive_source: use strict; use warnings; my $s = 'ab'; $s =~ s/a/b/r; 1;
rows.negative_source: use strict; use warnings; my $x = m/a/r; 1;
